name: tk_canonical_codex_cli
description: TokenKey canonical Codex CLI TLS profile captured from real codex ClientHello (Rust reqwest 0.12 + rustls 0.23 + aws-lc-rs, X25519MLKEM768 first); rustls randomizes extension order per connection, so shuffle_extensions=true and JA4 (not JA3) is the stable identity. Paired with codex_* User-Agent / originator. HTTPS advertises ALPN h2,http/1.1; the Responses WebSocket handshake sends the same hello without the ALPN extension.

https.ja3_hash_note: wire JA3 differs on every connection (22/22 distinct) because rustls shuffles extension order

observed.note: Captured by pointing codex at a local CONNECT capture proxy with a throwaway CODEX_HOME, dummy bearer and a local CA (CODEX_CA_CERTIFICATE); no request left the machine. ClientHello semantics are host-independent.
